Useful tags

    Header tags

  • H1: <h1>Biggest Heading<h1>

    Used to title the page

  • H2: <h2>Large Heading<h2>

    Used to separate big sections

  • H3: <h3>Medium Heading<h3>

    Used for smaller things like cards and columns

  • H4: <h4>Small Heading<h4>
  • H5: <h5>Mini Heading<h5>
  • H6: <h6>Smallest Heading<h6>

    • Even if you like the size/weight of a smaller heading, use the appropriate heading and style it with CSS to your liking.
